$comment: The source of sf-file-preview's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/file-preview (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

file-name.summary: The file's name, shown as the title of the row and used as its accessible name and as the download's file name.

file-size.summary: The file's size: a number of bytes (2457600), drawn in the page's language and units by the core's size format (2,3 МБ; decision C25) and said with the unit as a word (2,3 мегабайта; C51); text a host already wrote (12 KB) is drawn as written.

icon.summary: The glyph in the holder when no picture is shown (a Material Symbols name). Unset: the glyph of the file's type -- from mime-type, else from the name's extension (PDF, a sheet, slides, an archive, ... each its own; decision C81), else description.

href.summary: The file's address: the name is a link to it (decision C51; it downloads in the same tab, or opens in target when download is false) and the download action fetches it. Empty: the name is text and the download action does nothing.

kind.summary: What the preview shows: an icon, the image itself, or whichever suits the file.

mime-type.summary: The file's MIME type, which helps kind="auto" tell an image from another file.

image-url.summary: A picture to show in the holder for an image (kind image or auto): the thumbnail's address; empty uses href.

surface.summary: Draws the row on a fill, as a block of its own: the size 3 control height around the holder (56 on a desktop, 52 on a phone).

download.summary: true (the default): the download action saves the file under file-name, in the same tab. false: it opens the file instead, in target -- the same tab unless a target is given (C25).

target.summary: Where an opened file goes when download is false and where the name link goes: empty (the default) is the same tab, as C25 asks for a file link; _blank opens a new tab and the action shows the new-tab sign.

actions.summary: Shows the action buttons at the row's end (download and remove, as download-action and remove-action allow).

download-action.summary: Shows the download action among the actions.

remove-action.summary: Shows the remove action among the actions; it asks the page to detach the file (the detach event).

disabled.summary: Makes the row unavailable: the actions do nothing and the row takes the disabled look.

state.summary: The file's state, as the upload core's rows (decision C81). ready: the file is there -- the name is its link, the size under it, download and remove. uploading: the name as text, under it the upload row's bar with its per cent at the end (value; no value: the bar runs), aria-busy; remove stays (the host cancels), download is not offered. error: the name as text, under it «Не загрузился» and error-text in the error colour, «Повторить» (the retry event) at the end of the row -- under the text in a narrow row, where decision C88 places it -- and remove.

value.summary: While uploading: the share sent, per cent (0 to 100, clamped), drawn by the bar and its per cent. Absent: the bar runs without a share.

error-text.summary: Why the file did not upload, after «Не загрузился:» in a failed row (state error).

download-label.summary: Empty: the text of the page's language with the file's name («Скачать Отчёт.pdf», "Download Report.pdf" in English; decision C51).

remove-label.summary: Empty: the text of the page's language with the file's name («Удалить Отчёт.pdf», "Remove Report.pdf" in English; decision C51).

compact.summary: Only the leading visual, as tall as a list row's line: the image, or the file's extension in a tile. For a file in a table cell.

retry.summary: A person pressed «Повторить» in a row that did not upload (vocabulary §5 retry): the host sends the file again and sets state.

relations.name: cl-progress-bar
$comment: The upload row's bar under the name while the file uploads (state uploading, decision C81).

relations.name: cl-button
$comment: «Повторить» in a row that did not upload (state error), the C88 retry button.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: With its download or remove button the row is a group named by the host's aria-label, else the file name; Enter and Space press those native buttons (role button), so the group maps only Tab. The compact form is a link or an image named by the file.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-file-preview for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), detail-adds (the new detail holds the old fields), attribute-and-property, host-attribute (no shim), manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), retired (no new name; kept and noted by the component until the date).

rows.summary: Legacy name for file-size: the file's own size as text ("12 KB"), not the size ladder. Still honoured; pass file-size.

rows.section: the axis's old name (contracts/public-api-axes.json); its value default reads auto
rows.summary: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the element for the group's name; no shim
the new detail {id, action, value} holds the old fields
rows.summary: A download action was requested. Bubbles, is composed and is cancelable: preventDefault() stops the built-in navigation to href.

rows.note: the new detail {id, action, value} holds the old fields; bx-simai.property listens to the old name (vocabulary §9.2)
rows.summary: A remove action was requested. Bubbles, is composed and is cancelable; the component removes nothing itself.

rows.note: the actions are no longer hidden in a floating layer; the attribute does nothing
kept until the date and noted on each call; it writes the attribute open, which does nothing
kept until the date and noted on each call

x-summary: Accessible Smart projection of the ordinary File Preview row.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
events sf-file-preview:download → download (sf-file-preview-download), sf-file-preview:remove → detach (sf-file-preview-detach), vocabulary 1.1.5 §5 and §5.1; the detail adds id
settings.name → file-name, size → file-size, type → kind: the old names of compatibility.aliases, dated setting aliases
settings.avatar-size, values.open, methods setOpen and toggleOpen: no effect since 1.0.0 (compatibility.deprecations, open), retired with dates
values.compact → settings.compact: a setting the page writes, not a value the element holds
x-decisions: alias-conflict: sf-file-preview:remove takes the vocabulary's name sf-file-preview-detach (vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.1 lists exactly this rename); the alias table's sf-file-preview-remove never shipped (the code sent sf-file-preview:remove), so no row carries it.
version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: the events take the vocabulary's names and the old names, settings and methods are dated rows; a minor while they hold (§4.10).

events: download {id} and detach {id} by vocabulary §5 (cancelable requests: a page that prevents download keeps the browser from opening the file). id is the host's id, else href, else the file name. The detail keeps action and value for the old listeners (detail-adds), and carries no element (§8).
key-effects: the role group gives no keys; Enter and Space press the native download and remove buttons (role button), so the group maps only Tab: reach.
a11y-role: group written with when {actions: true} (a row with its buttons); otherwise none. The name is the host's aria-label (§3.1), else the file name.

existing-aliases: compatibility.aliases (name, size, type=default, avatar-size, open) and compatibility.deprecations (open) fold into aliases.json with the dates: name, size and type are setting aliases (default reads auto), avatar-size and open are retired, as are setOpen and toggleOpen.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json plus an image, the compact form and a disabled row; probe.json drives download and detach, the refusal and the aliases.
skeleton: none; the preview draws from its settings; an image that loads late keeps the holder's box (§5.4).
css-variables: seven public variables read by the class sheet with the role token as fallback (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (2026-11-10, docs precheck smart content FP-02, FP-03, FP-05): a minor. target's default is empty, the same tab (C25: a file link downloads or opens in the tab it is in; a new tab only for opening to view, with its sign): it was _blank, so download="false" and the name link opened a new tab by default; with target="_blank" and download false the action shows open_in_new. download and detach carry value.kind; value.type, its former name, stays beside it until 2027-01-01 (journal event-file-preview-value-type-to-kind). With component.file-preview 1.0.2 the row on a fill (surface) is 56 on a desktop and 52 on a phone (it was 72 and 60). Every setting has its summary.

version 1.2.1 (2026-11-13, docs precheck smart content FP-06, owner decision C103): a patch. The download and remove buttons are size 1 (40, icon 24) beside the size 1 name; they were 1/2 (32, icon 20).

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-14, file preview study FP-1, FP-2, FP-3, FP-6, FP-7, FP-8, FP-15; decisions C34, C88, C81, C51, C25): a minor. The name breaks only between words (C34): spaces and the joints names use instead of them (_ - – — / +) where a <wbr> lets a line end; it takes two lines at most and ends in an ellipsis, the whole name in its tooltip and for a screen reader (C88); it was overflow-wrap anywhere («верси | я_подписано.pdf»). The name is a link to the file while it is there (C51; the download request goes first and a page may refuse it). Unset icon: the glyph of the file's type from mime-type or the name's extension (picture_as_pdf, table_chart, slideshow, folder_zip, ...; C81), it was description for every file; a screen reader hears the type and the size after the name («Отчёт.pdf, PDF, 2,3 мегабайта», C51). file-size in bytes is drawn by the core's size format («2,3 МБ», C25); text stays as written. The buttons are named with the file («Скачать Отчёт.pdf», «Удалить Отчёт.pdf», C51); a page's own labels are kept. New settings state (ready, uploading, error), value and error-text: the upload core's rows (C81) -- the bar under the name while uploading, «Не загрузился: …» in the error colour and «Повторить» (event retry) after a failure. Words added: uploading-label, error-text, error-line, retry-text, retry-label; download-label and remove-label carry {name}. With component.file-preview 1.1.0; core holds the row's box before the code (FP-15).

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-file-preview for an already selected or attached file with visible metadata and optional native actions.
do_not: Do not use it for upload progress or transport
Do not hide actions in a hover-only or floating layer

accessibility.focus: Native file actions own focus-visible presentation.

sf-file-preview:download.summary: A download action was requested. Bubbles, is composed and is cancelable: preventDefault() stops the built-in navigation to href.

value.description: getValue(): fileName, fileSize, icon, href, type, mimeType, imageUrl, target.

sf-file-preview:remove.summary: A remove action was requested. Bubbles, is composed and is cancelable; the component removes nothing itself.

value.description: getValue(): fileName, fileSize, icon, href, type, mimeType, imageUrl, target.

getValue.summary: Return the current file identity and presentation value.

setOpen.summary: Legacy compatibility setter; actions remain visible.

toggleOpen.summary: Legacy compatibility toggle; actions remain visible.

aria-label.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("File" in English).
